data.description: A centrally located neighbourhood in Deira offering excellent connectivity, everyday conveniences, and family-friendly amenities. Ideal for residents seeking affordable living with access to schools, shops, and public transport.

data.answer: Hor Al Anz offers a comfortable urban lifestyle with amenities that support both individuals and families. Residents have access to local parks, schools, clinics, and supermarkets, as well as diverse dining options. With a range of housing options and excellent connectivity, the community ensures a balanced standard of living for people from various walks of life.

Hor Al Anz features a mix of apartments, villas, offices, and retail shops. Many properties are older but well-maintained, with spacious layouts and affordable price points compared to other areas in Dubai. The real estate options cater to a wide range of residents, from singles to large families.

Renting a Property in Hor Al Anz

Properties for rent in Hor Al Anz include studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments ideal for singles or small families. 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas are also available, along with offices and shops for commercial use. These properties for rent in Dubai attract both residents and entrepreneurs seeking affordable options.

Buying a Property in Hor Al Anz

You can also find properties for sale in Hor Al Anz, including studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, and spacious villas ranging from 4 to 6 bedrooms. With offices and retail spaces also on offer, it’s a viable choice for those exploring properties for sale in Dubai in a well-connected location.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Hor Al Anz?

data.answer:
Living in Hor Al Anz means enjoying a practical lifestyle in one of Deira’s most accessible districts. The area is filled with essential amenities like schools, shops, parks, and healthcare centres. Thanks to its location near Sheikh Zayed Road, residents benefit from smooth commutes and a range of facilities right at their doorstep.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Hor Al Anz

Hor Al Anz is well-connected to the rest of Dubai via Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), offering residents easy access across the city. Public transportation is robust, with Abu Hail Metro Station and several bus stops available. The area also features open and private parking spaces, adding convenience for residents and visitors.

Supermarkets in Hor Al Anz

Hor Al Anz has several supermarkets, including Talal Supermarket, Riqqat Al Madeena Supermarket, and United Hyper Market. In addition to these, numerous grocery stores are scattered throughout the area for daily essentials.

Shopping Malls in Hor Al Anz

Al Hamriya Shopping Centre is just a 6-minute drive from Hor Al Anz and offers a convenient mix of retail stores and service outlets. It’s a compact mall ideal for everyday shopping, mobile services, and quick errands. The presence of cafes and eateries makes it a useful spot for residents nearby.

Reef Mall, located about 10 minutes away, features a broader selection of retail stores, including fashion, electronics, and beauty outlets. It also houses casual dining options and family-friendly services. The mall’s manageable size and accessibility make it a favourite for locals in Deira.

City Centre Deira, around a 17-minute drive from Hor Al Anz, is one of Dubai’s top-tier shopping destinations. It boasts high-end international brands, a large Carrefour, a multiplex cinema, and an expansive food court. It’s a go-to destination for retail therapy, entertainment, and dining under one roof.

Schools and Nurseries near Hor Al Anz

Families in Hor Al Anz benefit from access to several schools, including Little Flower English School and the National Charity School – Primary, both of which offer quality education within proximity. Pearl Wisdom School is another option, known for its academic environment and extracurricular programs.

Omar Bin Al Khattab Model School also serves the area, offering a curriculum that supports well-rounded development. These institutions ensure that residents have reliable schooling options nearby for all age groups.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Hor Al Anz Location

Residents can visit mosques such as Hor Al Anz Mosque and Al Ansar Mosque, offering convenience for daily prayers.

For Hindu residents, temples in Bur Dubai, like the Shiva Temple and Shree Krishna Haveli, are around 20 to 22 minutes away.

Christian residents can access churches like St. Mary’s Catholic Church and Holy Trinity Church, both roughly 15 to 18 minutes away by car.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Hor Al Anz

Medical care is accessible with Aster Clinic located just 5 minutes away and Belhoul Speciality Hospital around 10 minutes from the area. These facilities provide general and specialized healthcare services to residents.

Hor Al Anz Location & Nearby Areas

Hor Al Anz is surrounded by vibrant communities such as Abu Hail, Al Baraha, Al Khabaisi, Al Muteena, Al Wuheida, and Al Muraqqabat. This proximity offers residents expanded access to additional services and lifestyle options.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Hor Al Anz

data.answer:
With its supermarkets, parks, restaurants, and family-friendly facilities, Hor Al Anz offers plenty of things to do. Residents enjoy an active lifestyle supported by various conveniences.

Hor Al Anz Restaurants

Hor Al Anz is home to diverse dining options such as Pearl Spice Restaurant, Sanaa Restaurant, Karachi, Darbar, Bangalore Memories Restaurant, and Eagle Restaurant, offering local and international cuisines.

Beaches near Hor Al Anz

Beaches like Jumeirah Public Beach, La Mer Beach, and Mercato Beach are located 20 to 25 minutes away. These coastal spots offer amenities such as swimming areas, cafes, and children’s play zones, perfect for weekend getaways.

Hotels in Hor Al Anz

For visitors and staycations, Grand Excelsior Hotel Deira and Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Dubai Deira are both located within a 10-minute drive, offering convenient and comfortable lodging options.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

In the wider Deira area, residents can enjoy local parks, walking tracks, and play areas. Fitness enthusiasts will find gyms and workout centres, while numerous salons cater to men's and women’s grooming needs.

Hor Al Anz Attractions and Landmarks

Dubai International Airport, just an 11-minute drive from Hor Al Anz, is one of the busiest airports in the world. It features extensive duty-free shopping, dining outlets, lounges, and world-class passenger services. Its proximity makes it highly convenient for frequent flyers and residents working in the aviation or travel industries.

Souk Al Seef, around 15 minutes from Hor Al Anz, offers a rich cultural experience along the Dubai Creek. Visitors can explore traditional architecture, dine at waterfront restaurants, and shop for artisanal goods and souvenirs. It’s a perfect destination for a relaxed evening or weekend outing with family and friends.

Zabeel Park is about a 17-minute drive from Hor Al Anz and is one of Dubai’s largest public parks. It features wide green spaces, barbecue areas, jogging tracks, and attractions like the Dubai Frame and Dinosaur Park. The park is ideal for fitness activities, family picnics, and outdoor leisure.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Hor Al Anz residents enjoy access to outdoor spaces, including nearby parks and recreational zones. Fitness centres cater to various workout styles, and numerous salons are available for both men and women in the area.

Hor Al Anz offers a practical lifestyle with excellent connectivity, affordable housing, and a full range of amenities. While it may be more crowded compared to newer communities, the area makes up for it with its strategic location, easy access to public transport, and essential services.

Where is Hor Al Anz located?

Hor Al Anz location is in Deira, Dubai, close to Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai–Sharjah border.

What types of properties are available in Hor Al Anz Dubai?

Hor Al Anz Dubai features apartments, villas, offices, and shops available for both rent and sale.

Which is the Hor Al Anz nearest metro station?

The nearest metro station is Abu Hail Metro Station, offering convenient access to Dubai’s Red Line.

Are there good schools in the Hor Al Anz Dubai area?

Yes, the area is served by schools like Little Flower English School and Pearl Wisdom School, providing quality education options.

Is Hor Al Anz suitable for families?

Yes, Hor Al Anz Dubai is family-friendly, with nearby schools, supermarkets, parks, and medical facilities catering to everyday needs.

data.content:
An established residential and commercial neighbourhood, Hor Al Anz is a bustling district in Dubai located within the vibrant region of Deira. Its prime location provides easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and is close to the Dubai–Sharjah border, ensuring strong connectivity for residents. The area also sits just minutes from Dubai International Airport, enhancing its convenience for frequent travellers.

Hor Al Anz is divided into two zones: Hor Al Anz West and Hor Al Anz East, Dubai. This layout ensures varied real estate options and caters to diverse resident needs. Whether you're looking for apartments, villas, offices, or shops, this area presents a well-balanced blend of residential and commercial properties for rent and sale. The neighbourhood is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and affordable lifestyle offerings.

Residents enjoy access to essential amenities such as schools, supermarkets, restaurants, parks, and medical centres. The area has built a reputation for its convenience, making it ideal for families, working professionals, and small business owners. With its blend of community services and commercial access, Hor Al Anz Dubai stands out as a practical place to live and work.
